website.note: Corporate site lists commercial diagnostic tests (DecisionDx-Melanoma, TissueCypher, AdvanceAD-Tx, DecisionDx-SCC, MyPath Melanoma, DecisionDx-UM); no drug clinical-stage pipeline page.

ctgov.note: All 12 hits actually belong to 'Castle Creek Biosciences, LLC.' — a different, unrelated company (gene therapy for dermatology). Castle Biosciences, Inc. (CSTL) itself sponsors observational / clinical-validation studies for its diagnostic tests, none of which are drug-intervention P1/P2/P3 trials. ctgov source not used for pipeline.

diagnostic_tests.name: DecisionDx-Melanoma
diagnostic_tests.modality: Gene expression profile (GEP) risk-stratification test for invasive cutaneous melanoma

diagnostic_tests.name: TissueCypher
diagnostic_tests.modality: Spatialomics risk-stratification test for Barrett's esophagus progression

diagnostic_tests.name: AdvanceAD-Tx
diagnostic_tests.modality: Non-invasive 487-gene GEP test guiding systemic therapy selection in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (JAK inhibitor vs Th2 profile)
diagnostic_tests.regulatory_status: Limited-access launch November 2025; phased expansion in 2026

diagnostic_tests.name: DecisionDx-SCC
diagnostic_tests.modality: GEP test predicting metastasis risk and adjuvant radiation response in high-risk cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma

diagnostic_tests.name: MyPath Melanoma
diagnostic_tests.modality: Diagnostic GEP test for difficult-to-diagnose melanocytic lesions

diagnostic_tests.name: DecisionDx-UM
diagnostic_tests.modality: GEP risk-stratification test for uveal melanoma metastasis

diagnostic_pipeline_disclosed_in_10k: Esopredict — methylation-based BE risk-stratification test acquired with Previse (May 2025); planned launch Q1 2026 as supplemental option to TissueCypher
Previse sponge-based, swallowable cell-collection device for non-endoscopic esophageal sampling — under development, subject to regulatory clearance
SciBase collaboration (June 2025) — non-invasive Electrical Impedance Spectroscopy diagnostic to predict atopic dermatitis flares; North America rights

excluded_partner_owned.note: 12 ctgov trials returned by sponsor search belong to 'Castle Creek Biosciences, LLC.' (gene therapy for recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa, etc.) — an unrelated entity. Excluded entirely; not part of CSTL.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Molecular diagnostics / lab-services company. Sells gene-expression-profile and spatialomics tests as laboratory-developed tests (LDTs); does not develop therapeutic drugs. Pipeline initiatives consist of new diagnostic assays (Esopredict methylation test, Previse swallowable cell-collection device, SciBase atopic-dermatitis flare predictor) — none are P1/P2/P3 drug trials. The clinicaltrials.gov sponsor search hits are for the unrelated company Castle Creek Biosciences.
